dict.string: Mycel finds people running Mycel nearby — on the same Wi-Fi or wired network, or directly over peer-to-peer Wi-Fi when there is no network — and sends them your encrypted messages directly, with no internet or server.
Mycel reads files you choose to attach from your Desktop so it can encrypt and send them.
Mycel reads files you choose to attach from your Documents folder so it can encrypt and send them.
Mycel reads files you choose to attach from your Downloads folder so it can encrypt and send them.
Mycel uses the microphone only during voice calls you place or answer. Your voice goes end-to-end encrypted, directly to the person you're talking to.
Mycel uses the camera only during video calls, when you turn it on. Your video goes end-to-end encrypted, directly to the person you're talking to.
Mycel uses Bluetooth to reach nearby devices running Mycel when there is no Wi-Fi, and sends them your end-to-end encrypted messages directly.
